name: Feked (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of blue and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Feked (a shield of blue and white with a yellow monogram and a rose) above a yellow scroll inscribed FEKED.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
